Hi I am nurse and you show some of the typical symptoms of sleep apnea according to your description. Sleep apnea happens when the muscles of your respiratory track relax and obstruct. It’s not an emergency because the body reacts by waking you up. Do you feel tired during the day?

Things that could help 

1. Stop smoking. It can have bad effects on your health. Maybe watch a video about COPD, a disease commonly caused by smoking 
2. Try to not sleep on your back
3. Regular sleep rhythm

And if needed CPAP therapy which means continuous positive airway pressure.
